backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features, associated files, components, and test IDs for the project.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains pre-written summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and OKLCH-based light/dark theme color variables.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with routes for home, reactions index, and reaction detail pages.
frontend/src/components/NotesImageViewer: Component showing note images with hover effects and a dialog-based zoom view.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Provides shared site layout with header navigation, routed content, and footer.
frontend/src/data/namedReactions.ts: Static list of named reactions with titles, slugs, descriptions, and image paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth handling, exposing login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook returning no backend queries for the static frontend.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables for light and dark modes, global styles, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, credits, and feature cards linking to the reactions list.
frontend/src/pages/NamedReactionsIndexPa: Displays a list of named reactions with descriptions and links to their individual pages.
frontend/src/pages/ReactionPage.tsx: Shows a specific reaction’s title, description, and its associated notes images with navigation back.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and content paths.
project_state.json: Stores metadata about project state, features, requirements, and required static images.
